ingestion_flows.source_description: Metaflow test 003: batch Auto Loader customer extract, later reconciled against the Zerobus bronze table

reconciliation_flows._test_case_note: TC-R2-001: flipped to execution_mode 'pipeline' -- this scenario is already structurally the geneva shape (a Bronze source produced by this same group's own ingestion flow, reconciled against an external zerobus-produced target, healing into that zerobus flow's own raw source bus in a DIFFERENT dataflow group) so it doubles as a before/after regression proving R2 (source-plane read-once) on an EXISTING passing scenario rather than only on new fixtures. dataflow_group_id is required by V-CYC-6 whenever execution_mode is pipeline-mode; set to this spec's own group so the flow registers into df_metaflow_003's own Lakeflow pipeline update. append_target_table ({{catalog}}.Excalibur_usecase.zerobus_source_bus) is dfg_metaflow_002_zerobus_bronze's own zerobus ingestion source -- genuinely a different dataflow group/spec document, so V-CYC-3/4 do not fire from this document alone (see docs/13's cross-pipeline feedback loop limitation); the live cross-group loop is the same one V-CYC-4 would WARN about if 002 and 003 were ever combined into one spec.
reconciliation_flows.transform_sql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name, status, current_timestamp() AS updated_at FROM _reconciliation_unmatched_records
